# EvaluLabs — full capability notes

Canonical site: https://www.evalulabs.com

EvaluLabs is a free candidate portal and AI interview platform operated as a
web app. It is not Evalulab (evalulab.com), a cosmetics testing lab in Montreal.

## Candidate portal

Free for candidates while the platform-free setting is on (the default). The
only paid candidate option is ATS Unlimited, 199 INR per month, which removes
the daily ATS check limit.

- Profile: built once from an uploaded resume (one model call when configured,
  deterministic parsing otherwise), then edited by hand. Tabs for profile,
  applications, saved jobs and job preferences.
- Live jobs: read from 1,100+ companies' own public career boards (Greenhouse,
  Lever, Ashby, SmartRecruiters, Workday, Keka, Freshteam) plus the Remotive and
  Arbeitnow feeds. Swept every 5 hours; closed roles disappear and postings
  older than 60 days are removed. Jobs located in or open to India are shown
  first, with a Worldwide toggle. Filters: roles/skills/companies, locations,
  work mode, an experience range, posted-within. A best-match toggle and sort
  use a profile match score (skills, target role, level, work mode, location).
  Same-title openings at one company are stacked into one card.
- ATS resume check: deterministic scoring against a job description, no model
  required. Skills and keywords 60, experience 15, job title 10, education 5,
  resume structure 10 (parts a posting does not mention are dropped and the
  rest re-weighted). Returns matched, implied and missing keywords and
  suggestions. 15 checks per day free. An optional second-opinion model may
  run when configured; any failure falls back to the keyword result.
- Apply kit: profile details as copy-ready fields next to the company's own
  application form, optionally in an always-on-top floating panel. EvaluLabs
  does not fill or submit forms on other sites. Opening the form records the
  application in the tracker.
- Application tracker: status and notes per application, saved jobs, and
  manual entries for roles found elsewhere. Saved rows keep a snapshot if the
  posting closes.
- Role practice: for each tracked application, questions from the matching
  company's bank, skill tracks from the posting, role-family defaults, HR and
  behavioural questions, and a static library. Typed answers are keyword-scored
  instantly. Coding questions open an editor; code is not executed.

## Candidate practice (AI mock interviews)

1. The candidate picks a company and role, or a skill, then a round.
2. POST start creates an interview session. Duration is randomized between 45
   and 60 minutes. The interviewer system prompt uses the company's tone when
   one of formal_strict, casual_friendly, or aggressive is set.
3. Each turn is appended to the session transcript and sent to the model.
4. Voice mode transcribes speech and keeps the same conversation.
5. Coding questions open Monaco (textarea fallback) for JavaScript, TypeScript,
   Python, Java, C++, or Go. System-design questions open a written workspace.
   Submit and debounced in-progress check-ins are sent to the interviewer.
   Code is not executed against hidden tests.
6. Ending the session grades the transcript: communication, technical depth,
   problem solving, overall, on 0-10. The rubric is strict; empty answers score
   at the bottom of the scale. Sessions on plans with insights (every
   candidate while the platform is free) also get a topic breakdown and
   improvement areas.

Public question banks are filled by contributors who verify with a company
email or an offer letter. A separate admin pipeline can research
candidate-reported questions; that is not the same as inventing questions in
the live interviewer.

## Enterprise screening

Organizations get a workspace to upload questions (csv, xlsx, json), invite
candidates, and read score reports. Colleges can attach a granted plan to an
email domain for a set number of interviews per cycle, without changing the
student's own subscription fields.

Proctoring is limited to enterprise invites that enable it:

- Camera permission is required. Denied access, or a disconnect past the grace
  period, blocks the interview.
- Reported checks: no face, multiple faces (face-api, streak confirmation),
  phone in frame (COCO-SSD), tab/window visibility, paste, devtools-dock size
  heuristic (logged as suspicious activity).
- Short clips around 15 seconds, a violation cap that can auto-end the session,
  and org live camera viewing.
- Not reported as violations: gaze-away, low light.

Published enterprise prices (INR, which is what checkout charges): 199 per
seat per month, 19999 per month unlimited. Display currency on the site may
convert those amounts for readers outside India.

## Do not infer

- No claim of a pass rate, placement rate, or number of candidates assessed.
- No claim that EvaluLabs applies to jobs on a candidate's behalf.
- No automated test-suite grading.
- No gaze or low-light proctoring.
- Practice catalog pages (/companies, /skills) describe the banks; opening a
  round requires an account.
